final_answer: Neural networks demand extensive training data and computational power, often requiring terabytes of datasets and thousands of GPU-hours. The resource intensity of training neural networks necessitates careful consideration of data availability, computational infrastructure, and training algorithms. Factors influencing these requirements include the network architecture, training algorithm, and the complexity of the learning problem. Notably, the availability of vast amounts of training data and the exponential increase in computational power have significantly enabled the training of increasingly complex neural networks in recent years.
